name: Jarvis 35.0
notes: New 🚪 Log out (lock the app, or log out and remove your key on a shared / office computer). Owner: open with your fingerprint on the phone or your own easy password on a laptop – the owner code is needed only once per device. Also: "Set up with a password" for laptops without Windows Hello, and a new app key (old unlock keys no longer work – ask the owner for a new key).
